component.name: Signall
component.summary: Sign PDFs and forms with your CAC

description.p: Signall signs PDFs with a US DoD Common Access Card (CAC). Open a PDF, fill it in, click a signature field or draw a box, and enter your PIN. The signatures validate in Adobe Acrobat.

ul.li: Any PDF: draw a box where the signature goes
PDF forms: fill in the fields and sign in the form's own signature field
XFA forms such as DD Form 2875 and DD Form 2842, including forms several people sign in turn
Signatures carry the DoD certificate chain and revocation data, like Acrobat's
A smart card check that explains reader, card, and certificate problems

description.p: Signall is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Department of Defense, DISA, or Adobe.
First release: the GNOME app and the signall command line.
